# Test Fixtures

This directory contains redistributable, lawful fixtures for rendering regression, search, annotation round-trip, and security tests.

- `minimal.pdf` — generated via pdf-lib, 1 page, text "Hello VelocePDF" — no restrictions.
- `small.pdf` — 1 page with outline
- `blank.pdf` — blank page for visual baseline
- Additional synthetic fixtures are generated in tests via pdf-lib where needed (large books, bomb, malformed).

All fixtures are MIT-licensed or public domain.
